title: Tile Merge
author: cobanov
description: Slide chunky number tiles around a little table board and merge equal pairs. Play the classic 4x4 to 2048, a tight 3x3 to 256 or a roomy 5x5 to 4096, each with its own best and saved game, and keep going after the goal.

controls.D-pad: Slide the tiles / choose in menus
controls.B: Back / resume / title after the goal or game over
